description: Join 2 to 20 PDFs into one, in the order given. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_ids.description: file_ids from get_upload_link, in order. One upload link can hold several files: the user may choose them all at once there, and they come in the order chosen.

file_urls.description: Or public https links to each PDF, in order. Result links from other YangOpen tools work too.

name: merge_pdf
title: Merge PDFs into one
